editorial.description_en: Overcast night with nothing showing through it. Violet-leaning, and dark enough that the hue survives only because the chroma was kept up.
editorial.description_ja: 星の見えない夜空のような、暗い青紫。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.310, C 0.078, h 272.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 星 (hoshi, star) + 無 (nashi, without). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Starless" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 星無. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — samu-boshi at ΔE00 3.7, fuka-yoi at ΔE00 4.8, shizumi-ao at ΔE00 6.8. complementary is the entry nearest the opposite OKLCh hue (92°), within 22°. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
